import pytest

from slotplan.align_to_grid import align_to_grid


def test_floor_and_ceil():
    assert align_to_grid(608, 15, "floor") == 600
    assert align_to_grid(601, 15, "ceil") == 615
    assert align_to_grid(-10, 15, "floor") == -15


def test_nearest():
    assert align_to_grid(608) == 615
    assert align_to_grid(645, 30) == 630


def test_bad_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        align_to_grid(600, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        align_to_grid(600, 15, "up")


def test_regression_issue_118():
    assert align_to_grid(645, 30) == 660

acceptance/test_format_agenda.py.final:
import pytest

from slotplan.format_agenda import format_agenda


def test_ordering():
    assert format_agenda([("Design review", 600, 690), ("Standup", 540, 555)]) == ["09:00-09:15  Standup (15m)", "10:00-11:30  Design review (1h 30m)"]
    assert format_agenda([("B", 540, 600), ("A", 540, 600), ("C", 540, 570)]) == ["09:00-09:30  C (30m)", "09:00-10:00  A (1h)", "09:00-10:00  B (1h)"]


def test_late_meetings():
    assert format_agenda([("Late call", 1410, 1440)]) == ["23:30-24:00  Late call (30m)"]
    assert format_agenda([("Release", 1380, 1500)]) == ["23:00-01:00+1  Release (2h)"]


def test_invalid_meeting():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_agenda([("Broken", 600, 600)])

acceptance/test_free_slots.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.free_slots import free_slots


def test_gaps():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (780, 840)], 540, 1020) == [(540, 600), (660, 780), (840, 1020)]
    assert free_slots([(500, 560), (1000, 1100), (620, 650), (600, 630)], 540, 1020) == [(560, 600), (650, 1000)]
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (700, 720)], 540, 1020, min_length=45) == [(540, 600), (720, 1020)]


def test_buffer():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660)], 540, 720, buffer=10) == [(540, 600), (670, 720)]
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (690, 750)], 540, 1020, min_length=30, buffer=15) == [(540, 600), (765, 1020)]


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        free_slots([], 600, 540)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        free_slots([], 540, 600, buffer=-5)


def test_regression_issue_433():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660)], 540, 720, buffer=10) == [(540, 590), (670, 720)]

acceptance/test_shift_weekly.py.final:
import pytest

from slotplan.shift_weekly import shift_weekly


def test_simple_shift():
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 600, 660)], -120) == [(0, 480, 540)]
    assert shift_weekly([(2, 540, 600), (1, 900, 960)], 330) == [(1, 1230, 1290), (2, 870, 930)]


def test_week_wraps():
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 60, 120)], -120) == [(6, 1380, 1440)]
    assert shift_weekly([(6, 1380, 1410)], 90) == [(0, 30, 60)]


def test_crossing_midnight():
    assert shift_weekly([(4, 1320, 1410)], 60) == [(4, 1380, 1440), (5, 0, 30)]
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 30, 90)], -60) == [(0, 0, 30), (6, 1410, 1440)]


def test_invalid_entry():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        shift_weekly([(7, 0, 60)], 0)
